name: roadmap
description: Roadmap + backlog graph with a work profile: engineering (GitHub-first Gauntlet Loop — frozen-bar cloud implementation, independent exact-SHA criticism, frozen-lead acknowledgment, lead-synthesized repair, fresh re-criticism; /fanout across slices, /gauntlet within one, /sync reconciles merged PRs) or general (meta.profile: general — the same planning rituals and review loop on document artifacts: /assign hands a slice to a person, /conduct runs critic → ack → repair on a file at a commit, /sync reconciles acknowledged passes). YAML is canonical planning state.

interface.shortDescription: A roadmap and backlog graph with conducted, independently reviewed execution.
interface.longDescription: Roadmap keeps docs/roadmap/roadmap.yaml and backlog.yaml canonical and renders SLICES.md and BACKLOG.md from them. Skills plan, scope, prioritize and run the review loop: the Gauntlet on GitHub PRs under the engineering profile, conduct on a file at a commit under the general profile. NOTE: in Codex the skills and hooks load from this plugin (hooks once trusted); the graph MCP server is registered separately with roadmap init --client codex --apply, which runs codex mcp add. The plugin's agents are not loaded by Codex.
defaultPrompt: Plan the next slice of the roadmap
Reconcile the roadmap with merged PRs
